operation.summary: Start an approver recovery when the last approver is lost: the approver list is cleared after 72 hours of running time unless a listed approver cancels. Not available yet: refused with platform_unsupported and remaining_steps until alert email delivery and a cancel action on the approver device exist; explicit owner.configuration grant required
operation.returns: state (none|pending|cancelled|cleared), started_by, started_at, clear_at, time_left_ms, ended_by, ended_at, can_start, blocked_reason (not_available|owner_email_required|no_approver)

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice
